role: oracle for structure, not for drift (uniform cases exact)

modified.description: pip-installed fmmax release, used as shipped

install.command: conda create -y -n fwref python=3.11 && conda run -n fwref pip install fmmax

references.settings: in-layer E/H via fmmax.fields.layer_fields_3d; x-only binary grating (eps 4.0 bar, fill 0.4) and uniform 2.25 slab, WL 620, period 400, thickness 260, theta 0/24/41, s/p; plus 2D crossed patch (eps 4.0 on vacuum) and uniform control, WL 630, period 500, thickness 50, theta 41, phi 0; layer Formulation.JONES_DIRECT, vacuum FFT; rasters transposed [y,x]->[x,y]
references.discretization: Truncation.PARALLELOGRAMIC: 25 terms (5x5, matched to truncation_order=(2,2)) for the 1D cases; 49 and 361 terms (orders 3 and 9) for the 2D patch; vector factorization differs from Wavebit's, ~1e-4 (grating) and ~3e-2 (patch)

environment.other: jax 0.10.2, jaxlib 0.10.2, conda env fwref; jax_enable_x64=True set by the generator
